scope: Paired descriptive640 scenarios per model on identical BTC/ETH/SOL Wallex histories and independent accounts. No test winner adopted.

shared_identity.features: Identical Wallex relative-v2 ten channels and eight query features; symbol IDs remapped by name
shared_identity.interpretation: Delivered old three-seed versus new one-seed models; venue/task held fixed. Does not isolate architecture or training-data effects.
shared_identity.limitation: Chronologically after both frozen models training/calibration; old test has already been inspected in previous work, so not project-wide untouched.

new_training_query_policy: Existing ex-ante query_distances:64 per direction,128 per origin; generated deterministically, not duplicated on disk.
semantics: Strict absolute P(TP first by H)>p; long spot; one-minute latency; same-symbol overlap blocked; shared cash per scenario; TP/SL only, no expiry/data-end sale.
accounting: Cash-funded long spot only, one position per asset, max15% allocation, .5% equity risk, $1 min notional, shared cash. Existing barrier_only simulator. Sizing equity is cash plus open quantity times entry reference price, not current marked equity. Four assets make native cap5 equivalent to cap4 here. Fractional quantities are paper proxies.
execution_limit: Historical bid/ask and depth unavailable. Assumed per-side spread/slippage combined friction; price-touch signal replay, not verified executable fills.
limitations: Old three-seed versus new one-seed; different training venues/data/pretraining. Same baseline-compatible ten channels, all activity/age/local/level flags false. Does not isolate architecture. Previously inspected historical TEST, statistically dependent rows.
